title: SOM v0.3 Message Envelope (DRAFT 2, 2026-06-10)
description: Envelope per v0.3 Technical §4.1, decision #18 lock. Wire som_version remains 0.2.0 until v0.3 ratifies; this schema describes the TARGET shape. payload is polymorphic on message_type — see som-v0.3-story-context.schema.json and som-v0.3-skill-warning.schema.json.

correlation_id.description: Required as of v0.3 (decision #18); links all messages about the same story lifecycle

causation_id.description: Optional; ID of the message that directly caused this one

timestamp.description: Microsecond precision recommended. Skill-output timestamp lives HERE, not in the payload (decision #18)

modification_header.description: On snapshot-style messages such as story.context

_actors.description: Key-value map of short-key actor lookups

extensions.description: Vendor fields, reverse-domain namespaced (com.{vendor}.*); consumers ignore-if-unknown

@context.description: JSON-LD context — DEFERRED in v0.3 (decision #18); permitted for forward compatibility

originating_system.description: Renamed from `source` (first leg of the four-way source disambiguation)
